scene.name: Life as an adventurer
scene.goal: Take jobs, climb the ranks and survive Adolion.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: The receptionist behind the long counter is an elven woman with green eyes; half the men at the tables are pretending not to stare at her.

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: I step up to the counter. "I want to sign up. What level does a new member start at, and what kind of jobs can I take on day one?"

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Night in the shanty streets of the capital, where the houses are built from scrap wood and thieves watch every stranger. A thin young man sells canvases from a blanket.

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: I crouch by the paintings. The faces in them look exactly like the ones on the missing-person notices. "Who signs these? And who buys something this gruesome?"

transcript.speaker: Arin
transcript.text: "You want to go south? Into the green hell that swallows a quarter of the continent? The things in there are twisted by whatever leaks out of that place."

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: "And the gray-skinned warriors with the red eyes? I heard thousands of them live down there under a single chief."

transcript.speaker: The barbarian
transcript.text: She rests her huge stone axe on her shoulder. "I was born up there, in the snow peaks where the wall between worlds is thin. My people still wander those passes."

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: "Your people. The ones who think a woman's place is the cooking fire? No wonder you left."

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Three riders in red cloaks, holy symbols gleaming on their breastplates, block the road. Their leader says they hunt heresy wherever it hides.

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: "You think the baron isn't the baron anymore? That something from below is wearing his skin? Then how do you drive it out?"

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: The alchemist unrolls a map and taps a dark mass of trees. "The rarest ingredients grow there. So do the worst monsters in the land."

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: "I heard a green wyrm rules those woods, with little lizard-folk serving him. Will they let us through if we pay?"

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: The abandoned mansion is all cobwebs and cracked windows. In a child's bedroom upstairs, a porcelain doll turns its head to follow you.

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: "The villagers said the family here was butchered by church hunters centuries ago. One daughter was never found."
